description: The interpreter is pinned by hand in .python-version and has to stay in step with requires-python, so neither is left to Renovate. The compose files reference ghcr.io/syv-ai/hyperqwen:latest, which carries no resolvable version, so the docker-compose manager has nothing to track there either. flake.lock is kept current by lock file maintenance, not by a digest rule: flake inputs here pin no rev in flake.nix, so the nix manager only ever emits lockedVersion updates.

packageRules.description: Group non-major CI action updates in .forgejo/workflows; major bumps get their own PR

Bump the interpreter by hand: .python-version pins a uv-flavoured build (a +gil or +freethreaded suffix), which the pyenv manager cannot resolve because it looks versions up in the Docker registry, and cannot rewrite without dropping the suffix
Keep requires-python in step with .python-version, which is managed by hand
